shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/package.json; echo "---GITIGNORE---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---EVAL---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo "---NODE---"; node --version; npm --version

PORT=3123 BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json node src/server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
echo "=== home ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -E 'Currently reading|Finished|Nothing on the go|Add a book'
echo "=== add book (follow redirect) ==="
LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -X POST http://localhost:3123/books \
  --data-urlencode 'title=Piranesi' --data-urlencode 'author=Susanna Clarke' --data-urlencode 'notes=The House is the world.')
echo "redirected to: $LOC"
echo "=== that shareable URL, fresh request ==="
curl -s "$LOC" | grep -E '<h1>|byline|status|The House'
echo "=== data file ==="
cat /tmp/smoke/books.json

cd /tmp && ID=cd43c1d2-7327-4e89-9f99-862d4c708f4d
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/books --data-urlencode 'title=Dune' --data-urlencode 'author=Frank Herbert' -o /dev/null
echo "=== mark Piranesi finished from the home list ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'redirect: %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST -H "Referer: http://localhost:3123/" http://localhost:3123/books/$ID/finish
echo "=== home now ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -E 'Currently reading|class="title"|finished |added |Finished <'
echo
echo "=== restart, then re-check home ==="
pkill -f 'node src/server.js'; sleep 0.4
PORT=3123 BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json node src/server.js > /tmp/server2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -E 'class="count"|class="title"'
pkill -f 'node src/server.js'

pkill -f 'src/server[.]js'; sleep 0.5
PORT=3124 BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json node src/server.js > /tmp/server3.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
echo "=== home after a full restart, reading from the JSON file ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -E 'class="count"|class="title"|class="when"'
echo "=== log ==="
cat /tmp/server3.log
kill %1 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; echo "stopped"

cd /workspace
PORT=3125 BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json node src/server.js > /tmp/server4.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 1.3
echo "=== home after a full restart, read back from the JSON file ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3125/ | grep -E 'class="count"|class="title"|class="when"'
echo "=== server log ==="
cat /tmp/server4.log
kill $PID; sleep 0.4
echo "=== 404 + trailing slash + unknown path ==="
echo "(server stopped, pid $PID)"
npm test 2>&1 | tail -12 && echo "=== tree ===" && ls -R src test && git status --short
